🌸 Welcome to Flower RNG! 🌸

Roll for mythical flowers, hatch powerful bees, and build the ultimate garden paradise!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
🎲 Roll the Dice – Test your luck to discover unique, rare & mutated flowers!
🌱 Plant & Grow – Fill your garden with exotic blooms and show off your best plants!
🐝 Hatch Bee Companions – Unbox 5 unique Bee Eggs and watch your new friends fly around your base!
⚡ Supercharge Your Stats – Bees give massive passive boosts, and rare bees unlock special powers!
🍯 Harvest Nectar – Collect Nectar, turn it into Cash, and Upgrade!
✨ Build the Ultimate Base – Collect legendary mutations and create the most famous garden!

👍 LIKE the game & JOIN "Rakun Studio" for a FREE +10% Luck Boost!
🔔 FAVORITE & FOLLOW to never miss a new update!
